seasonal-tapes.title: Seasonal Tapes
seasonal-tapes.description: A complete four-season collection composed in OpenBand — from spring blossoms and coastal summer afternoons to crimson autumn alleys and snowy twilight cafés.

TurnRiver.title: TurnRiver
TurnRiver.subtitle: 6-Max Texas Hold'em Training Studio
TurnRiver.description: Train 100bb No-Limit Hold'em with preflop ranges, postflop decision drills, pot odds & EV math, range reading, and interactive bot tables.

one-law.title: ONE LAW
one-law.subtitle: Five Realities from a Single Equation
one-law.description: Five synchronized physical realities driven by one symplectic differential equation — packaged in a single zero-dependency HTML file.

quick-decide.title: Quick Decide
quick-decide.subtitle: Offline-First Decision Helper
quick-decide.description: A calm, zero-friction decision helper designed to cut through everyday low-stakes decision fatigue — installable and works fully offline.

intelligence-age.title: Age of Intelligence
intelligence-age.subtitle: How to Thrive When Intelligence Is Abundant
intelligence-age.description: A practical field guide to judgment, mastery, economic resilience, relationships, and meaning in the age of AI.

sakura-and-raindrops.title: Sakura & Raindrops
sakura-and-raindrops.description: A gentle spring day along rain-washed cherry-blossom canals — morning dew bells, breezy bicycle rides, sunshower Rhodes, matcha terraces, and petals on wet stone.

four-oclock-coast.title: Four O'Clock Coast
four-oclock-coast.description: One sunlit coastal day in six scenes — crisp morning linen, four o'clock sea breeze, poolside funk-bossa, amber pier sunset, neon cicada dusk, and midnight shoreline.

maple-and-lanterns.title: Maple & Lanterns
maple-and-lanterns.description: An unhurried October day from crisp chestnut mornings to lantern-lit riverbanks — secondhand bookshops, golden ginkgo walks, crimson maple twilight, and roasted tea.

kettle-and-snowfall.title: Kettle & Snowfall
kettle-and-snowfall.description: A cozy snowy day from frost on the morning glass to midnight streetlamps — warm felt piano, mellow Rhodes, dusty swung boom-bap drums, and delicate music-box bells.
